surface: Complete published react-hot-toast 2.6.1 surface: the callable `toast` API with every variant, promise lifecycle, dismissal and removal, `Toaster`, `ToastBar`, `ToastIcon`, the icon components, multiple toasters, hover pause, `useToaster`, `useToasterStore`, `resolveValue`, and the `/headless` entry. All 14 upstream Jest cases run unchanged against React and against the port.
divergences: The Toaster pauses on native `mouseenter`/`mouseleave` events on its container; tests fire them there rather than on a toast.
goober's `setup()` is never called, so an application's goober pragma stays in place.
The root and `/headless` entries share one toast store; upstream bundles each with its own.
Renderables, styles and refs use Octane types; the icon components are typed as Octane components over `div` props.
ssr: Supported and tested: `Toaster` and queued toasts server-render without browser globals, matching React's markup, and `hydrateRoot` adopts the server container before showing client toasts.
